description: RP2040 peripheral registers at their addresses, reset values and field access, and its interrupt numbers, converted by tools/importers/svd2regs.py from Raspberry Pi's RP2040.svd (pico-sdk 2.0.0, src/rp2040/hardware_regs/RP2040.svd), Copyright (c) 2024 Raspberry Pi Ltd., SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause (LICENSES/BSD-3-Clause.txt). PPB (the Cortex-M0+'s own system space) is left out: the core models it. Where the SVD's reset values are not the part's, the models correct them (core/mcu/rp2040).
source: RP2040.svd from raspberrypi/pico-sdk 2.0.0, converted by tools/importers/svd2regs.py
